stem: Precipitation / Stoichiometry: What volume of $0.150\text{~M}\text{~BaCl}_{2}$ is required to completely precipitate all the sulfate ions from $25.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.200\text{~M}\text{~Al}_{2}\left( \text{SO}_{4} \right)_{3}$ solution?

Gravimetric Analysis: A $1.200\text{-g}$ sample containing chloride is dissolved in water and treated with excess $\text{AgNO}_{3}$, yielding $1.875\text{~g}$ of $\text{AgCl}$ precipitate. What is the mass percentage of chlorine in the original sample? (Atomic masses: $\text{Ag} = 107.87$, $\text{Cl} = 35.45$)

Acid-Base Titration (Back Titration): A $0.500\text{-g}$ antacid tablet containing $\text{CaCO}_{3}$ was treated with $50.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.100\text{~M~HCl}$. The excess acid required $6.2\text{~mL}$ of $0.150\text{~M~NaOH}$ for complete neutralization. What percentage by mass of the tablet is $\text{CaCO}_{3}$? ($\text{CaCO}_{3} = 100.09\text{~g/mol}$)
Conceptual Redox: Which of the following species can act both as an oxidizing agent and a reducing agent?

Solubility Rules: Which of the following pairs of aqueous solutions, when mixed, will not produce a precipitate?

Stoichiometry in Solutions: A $25.0\text{-mL}$ sample of an unknown monoprotic acid is neutralized by $32.4\text{~mL}$ of $0.128\text{~M~NaOH}$. What is the molar concentration of the acid?

Solution Preparation: How many grams of $\text{Na}_{2}\text{CO}_{3}$ ($105.99\text{~g/mol}$) are required to prepare $250.0\text{~mL}$ of a solution with a sodium ion concentration of $0.200\text{~M}$?

Titration Stoichiometry (Redox): A $0.300\text{-g}$ sample of iron ore is dissolved in acid, reducing all iron to $\text{Fe}^{2 +}$. Titrating the solution requires $25.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.0200\text{~M}\text{~KMnO}_{4}$ in acidic medium. What is the percentage of Fe ($55.85\text{~g/mol}$) in the ore?
Ideal Gas Law / Density: What is the density of carbon dioxide gas ($\text{CO}_{2}$) at $750\text{~mmHg}$ and $27^{\circ}\text{C}$?
Graham’s Law of Effusion: An unknown gas effuses through a pinhole $1.66$ times slower than $\text{CH}_{4}$ gas under identical conditions. What is the molar mass of the unknown gas?

Dalton’s Law of Partial Pressures: A mixture of $2.00\text{~g}$ of $\text{He}$ and $8.00\text{~g}$ of $\text{Ar}$ is placed in a rigid $5.00\text{-L}$ container at $25^{\circ}\text{C}$. What is the total pressure of the gas mixture?

Gas Stoichiometry over Water: Zinc metal reacts with hydrochloric acid to produce hydrogen gas:

$$\text{Zn}(s) + 2\text{HCl}(aq) \rightarrow \text{ZnCl}_{2}(aq) + \text{H}_{2}(g)$$

If $250\text{~mL}$ of $\text{H}_{2}$ is collected over water at $22^{\circ}\text{C}$ and a total pressure of $760\text{~mmHg}$ (vapor pressure of water at $22^{\circ}\text{C} = 19.8\text{~mmHg}$), how many moles of Zn were consumed?

Kinetic Molecular Theory: What is the root-mean-square speed ($u_{rms}$) of $\text{N}_{2}$ molecules at $27^{\circ}\text{C}$? ($R = 8.314\text{~J/(mol} \cdot \text{K)}$, molar mass of $\text{N}_{2} = 0.0280\text{~kg/mol}$)
Real Gases & Van der Waals Equation: For which of the following gases would you expect the Van der Waals constant '$a$' (representing intermolecular attractive forces) to be the largest?
Compressibility Factor ($Z$): Under what conditions do real gases deviate most significantly from ideal gas behavior?
